assertions.description: INCORRECT: SPI9341.sch has 4 non-power components: LCD_ILI9341_SPI (U?), Conn_01x07 (J?), Conn_01x04 (J?), Conn_01x05 (J?). The output reports total_components=2 and the BOM only shows 2 entries (1 IC + 1 connector value), missing the Conn_01x04 and Conn_01x05 variants because all three connectors share the same ref J?. The component_types shows only connector=1 instead of 3.
assertions.incorrect_review: rewrite (TH-105, 2026-11-06): locks the defect: total_components=2; schematic has 4 symbols (U?, 3x J? connectors sharing ref J?)
assertions.migration_note: TH-105: re-anchored to the value the review calls correct (was {"path": "statistics.total_components", "value": 2, "op": "equals"})

assertions.description: INCORRECT: The analyzer detects a half-duplex SPI bus with SCK on net '+3.3V' and MOSI on '__unnamed_14'. The ILI9341's SCK pin (pin 7) is connected directly to the +3.3V power rail in the schematic — this appears to be a design-in-progress error. The analyzer should not classify a power net as an SPI SCK signal. This is a false positive SPI detection because the SCK pin is erroneously tied to a power rail.
assertions.incorrect_review: graduate (TH-105, 2026-11-06): SCK now on __unnamed_13 (U? SCK + J? pin 7), not +3.3V; power-net SCK false positive gone
